extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning dataset consisting of 506 challenging instructions for evaluating large multimodal models. It contains human-written instruction-response pairs over text-rich images spanning eight real-world scenarios and requires joint reasoning over textual and visual cues.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.publisher: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 235)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was built by sourcing images from multiple existing corpora and scraped web links, shortlisting images through manual and heuristic filtering, annotating image-instruction-response triplets by author groups following guidelines, and verifying annotations with MTurk workers before removing incorrect samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of images from LAION-5B, the Rico Dataset, screenshots collected from website links provided by the Open WebText Initiative, and images from existing VQA test sets including InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotation proceeded in three stages: images were shortlisted via manual or heuristic filtering; authors were split into two groups to annotate four categories each following annotation guidelines; then MTurk workers verified each <image, instruction, response> sample, incorrect samples were filtered, and each author group reviewed the other group's samples for guideline adherence and quality control.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) was used for verification.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification by MTurk workers found that 96% of samples were annotated correctly; incorrect samples were filtered out, followed by cross-review between author groups.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators included the paper authors, divided into two groups; no further demographics are provided.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: PaddleOCR was used as a heuristic tool to detect text in images during annotation candidate selection.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Performance imbalance across visual categories may reflect lack of diversity in models' training data, with natural scenes overrepresented and categories like time and infographics underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is challenging and reveals that current models struggle especially on time-related and infographic reasoning; few-shot examples do not substantially improve performance. The released validation set is only a subset of the full dataset, while most samples remain hidden.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is motivated by real-world applications such as assisting visually impaired people in interpreting text-rich scenes and understanding abstract text-rich images like memes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended as a benchmark for evaluating large multimodal/foundation models on context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning. It can be used for model development via a released validation set and for evaluation on the hidden remainder; experiments also include zero-shot and few-shot evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to release 100 of 506 samples as a validation set with reference responses, while keeping the remaining 406 samples hidden; the validation set is sampled to mirror the overall dataset distribution. No update timeframe or deprecation policy is specified.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were filtered and sampled for annotation: manual filtering for some categories, heuristic OCR-based filtering for others, selecting the top 500 images with the highest number of words, and removing incorrectly annotated and low-quality samples to produce the final dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Heuristic filtering used PaddleOCR to detect text in images before selecting candidates for annotation.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce CONTEXTUAL, a novel dataset featuring human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images.

description.evidence: we propose CONTEXTUAL, a Context-sensitive Text-rich visual reasoning dataset consisting of 506 challenging instructions for LMMs evaluation. CONTEXTUAL covers eight real-world scenarios with text-rich images
